title: Glossary of the Reference Architecture and Guidance for DPI-H
description: The DPI-H Reference Architecture draft's own glossary as a SKOS scheme, one concept per term, read mechanically from the glossary table (folio/dpi-h-ra/glossary/, from the review draft who-dpi-h-reference-architecture-draft-v1). Definitions are verbatim; nothing is paraphrased or chosen. This is the shared scheme the Digital Transformation Handbooks (dth-hrh, dth-phc, dth-sc, dth-pc, dth-sfp) link their terms to (smart-ra#133, task S1). Where a DTH defines a term differently, its wording is added later as a cited alternative; none is chosen.

terms.definition: Standards-based, Machine-readable, Adaptive, Requirements-based, Testable Guidelines are a comprehensive set of reusable digital health components (e.g., interoperability standards, code libraries, algorithms, technical and operational specifications) that transform the guideline adaptation and implementation process to preserve fidelity and accelerate uptake.
